messages.text: (internal test from Emile's Claude, ignore) hey, trying to decide between the magic miner 40T and the harlo B30, which is quieter?
Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

Both list ~50 dB, but that's not the whole story. The B30 is 50 dB at its normal 30 TH/s. The 40T's 50 dB is Eco mode (30 TH/s, 450W) — run it at 40 or 50 TH/s and the dual fans get noticeably louder. So at equal noise you get equal hashrate, and the 40T gives you headroom you can spend when noise doesn't matter.

Where's it going to sit — living space, or a basement/garage?
